info.name: Project-Team-404 API - 343-search
info.description: Sprint 5 Search API acceptance checks. Requires supabase/seeds/010_search.sql.

exec: pm.test('Login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Login returns a token', function () { pm.expect(body.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.environment.set('token', body.token);
pm.test('Task title search returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Task exact, starts-with, and contains titles rank in order', function () { const titles = body.tasks.items.map((item) => item.title); pm.expect(titles.slice(0, 3)).to.eql(['Orbit', 'Orbit launch checklist', 'Planning around Orbit']); pm.expect(body.tasks.items[0].matchedField).to.equal('title'); });
pm.test('Type tasks leaves the projects group empty with total zero', function () { pm.expect(body.projects).to.eql({ items: [], total: 0 }); });

item.name: Task description - matched field and snippet

exec: pm.test('Task description search returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const item = pm.response.json().tasks.items.find((result) => result.title === 'Quarterly review notes');

pm.test('Description-only match identifies its field and snippet', function () { pm.expect(item).to.exist; pm.expect(item.matchedField).to.equal('description'); pm.expect(item.snippet).to.include('Orbit'); pm.expect(item.snippet.length).to.be.at.most(120); });
pm.test('Project name search returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Project exact, starts-with, and contains names rank correctly', function () { const names = body.projects.items.map((item) => item.name); pm.expect(names[0]).to.equal('Orbit'); pm.expect(names[1]).to.equal('Orbit launch workspace'); pm.expect(names).to.include('Planning around Orbit'); });
pm.test('Type projects leaves the tasks group empty with total zero', function () { pm.expect(body.tasks).to.eql({ items: [], total: 0 }); });

item.name: Project description - matched field and snippet

exec: pm.test('Project description search returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const item = pm.response.json().projects.items.find((result) => result.name === 'Weekly Notes');

pm.test('Description-only project match identifies its field and snippet', function () { pm.expect(item).to.exist; pm.expect(item.matchedField).to.equal('description'); pm.expect(item.snippet).to.include('Orbit'); pm.expect(item.snippet.length).to.be.at.most(120); });
pm.test('All-type search returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Limit applies separately to both groups without changing totals', function () { pm.expect(body.tasks.items.length).to.be.at.most(1); pm.expect(body.projects.items.length).to.be.at.most(1); pm.expect(body.tasks.total).to.be.greaterThan(1); pm.expect(body.projects.total).to.be.greaterThan(1); });
pm.test('Percent and underscore search returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Percent and underscore are literal characters', function () { pm.expect(body.tasks.total).to.equal(1); pm.expect(body.tasks.items[0].title).to.equal('Literal 50%_done marker'); });
pm.test('Backslash search returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Backslash is treated literally', function () { pm.expect(body.tasks.total).to.equal(1); pm.expect(body.tasks.items[0].title).to.equal('Literal \\x marker'); });

item.name: Deleted and other-user rows are excluded

exec: pm.test('Ownership and deletion search returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Soft-deleted task and project are never returned', function () { pm.expect(body.tasks.items.some((item) => item.title === 'Deleted Orbit task fixture')).to.equal(false); pm.expect(body.projects.items.some((item) => item.name === 'Deleted Orbit project fixture')).to.equal(false); });
pm.test('Another user task is never returned', function () { pm.expect(body.tasks.items.some((item) => item.title === 'James Orbit task fixture')).to.equal(false); });
pm.test('Default archive search returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Archived tasks, projects, and archived-project tasks are excluded', function () { pm.expect(body.tasks).to.eql({ items: [], total: 0 }); pm.expect(body.projects).to.eql({ items: [], total: 0 }); });
pm.test('Including archived results returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Archived tasks and projects are included', function () { pm.expect(body.tasks.items.some((item) => item.title === 'ArchiveNeedle archived task fixture' && item.isArchived)).to.equal(true); pm.expect(body.projects.items.some((item) => item.name === 'ArchiveNeedle archived project' && item.isArchived)).to.equal(true); });

pm.test('Active tasks in archived projects are included', function () { pm.expect(body.tasks.items.some((item) => item.title === 'Active ArchiveNeedle task in archived project' && !item.isArchived)).to.equal(true); });
pm.test('Other users results remain excluded', function () { pm.expect(body.tasks.items.some((item) => item.title === 'James ArchiveNeedle task fixture')).to.equal(false); });
pm.test('No-match search returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Both result groups are empty with total zero', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ tasks: { items: [], total: 0 }, projects: { items: [], total: 0 } }); });
pm.test('One-character query is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('Query longer than 100 characters is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('Limit above 20 is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('Missing bearer token is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
